0022600222.text: The Los Angeles Lakers (10-2, first in the Pacific and the West) bring a six-game winning streak and an 8-2 record over their last ten into their visit to the Milwaukee Bucks (1-10, 15th in the East). Milwaukee is on a seven-game losing streak, sits 6.5 games back in fifth place in the Central, and is 1-5 at home, while the Lakers are 5-1 on the road. Lakers guard Quentin Grimes is day-to-day with a finger injury and is a game-time decision, and Bucks guard Tyler Herro is out with a knee bruise. The teams have no games yet this season, split their 2025-26 series 1-1, and last met on January 9, 2026 in Los Angeles, where the Lakers lost 105-101.
